The Writ Petition has been filed in the nature of a Mandamus seeking a direction to the first respondent/ District Collector, Dindigul, to enhance the compensation already granted for the land acquired by the second respondent in Survey Nos.823/2E, 823/2C, 823/3 measuring 2299 square meter at Thalaiyuthu Village and Post, Palani Taluk, Dindigul District.
